user.title: Step 1: Number of Zones & Day/Night Schedule

data.schedule_enabled: Enable automatic Day / Night hourly schedule

zone.title: Step 2: Zone Thermostat {zone_num} of {zone_total}
zone.description: Configure the zone valve, temperature sensor, and target temperatures for Day, Night, and Away modes.

data.zone_name: Zone name (e.g. Day Zone, Night Zone, Floor 1)

heater_and_safety.title: Step 3: Heat Generator, Safety (Watt + Timer Fallback) & Notifications
heater_and_safety.description: When a power sensor (Watts) is configured for the heat generator, it decides when to close the cooldown valve (below threshold W), using the timer as a fallback if the sensor becomes unavailable.

data.exclusive_control: Exclusive Control (hides physical switches and reverts manual toggles)
data.power_sensor: Heat Generator power sensor in Watts (optional)
data.power_threshold_watt: Minimum power threshold (Watts) for cooldown & manual ignition
data.cooldown_minutes: Fallback heat dissipation timer (minutes, used if power sensor is unavailable)
data.cooldown_zone_id: Zone valve to open for heat dissipation / safety
data.use_separate_manual_zone: Use another valve for manual ignition

manual_zone.title: Step 4: Manual Ignition Safety Valve
manual_zone.description: Select which zone valve to open when heat generator power consumption exceeds the threshold while idle.

data.manual_safety_zone_id: Zone valve to open on manual ignition (> threshold W)
